theme.description: The design-system selection iarch-theme renders from, added in Part 2. It sits alongside the coarse Part-1 'preset' master switch and the 'effects' toggles rather than replacing them: 'colour_preset' names one of the palettes in data/design/presets/ (validated at runtime against that directory, so the list stays open), and 'intensity' names one of the four the tokens define. configstore.load merges the repository default under a user's file, so a settings.json written before this block existed still resolves a theme. iarch-theme apply writes both keys back here; reconciling them with the coarse 'preset'/'effects' switches is Part 4 settings-app work.
